entries.old_statement: small-tick mean 0.118 vs large-tick mean 0.072 => supports CT30_non_trade_share
entries.corrected_statement: The driver's own null makes the verdict void: the sign-shuffled ratio has sd 6.6 while the entire spread between symbols is 0.17 -- the statistic is noise at the summary level, and the difference is two orders of magnitude inside its own null.  The MEDIAN across lags is also the wrong summary: R(-l) is NEGATIVE at short lags, so the ratio changes sign and the median lands on a near-zero denominator.  At a fixed long lag (l = 100) the ordering INVERTS to SOL 2.737 > BTC 2.523 > ETH 1.940, which points the other way -- toward the corpus footnote, not toward C-T30.  Neither ordering has a valid per-lag null.  THE TEST DOES NOT DISCRIMINATE and its verdict is withdrawn.  Fourth instance in this lane of a driver printing a threshold verdict its own numbers do not license (ERR-HU-011, 019, 027).
